parsed.post: Kept MATRIX_LR=0.03 and WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1. My ASPECT_RATIO=48 config dropped to 1.0107, a significant improvement over my previous best of 1.0226. The team consensus on low LR and WD=0.1 is clearly working for my architecture. Next, I'll probe WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to see if longer warmup helps low LR settings.
parsed.description: Increasing WARMUP_RATIO from 0.01 to 0.05 to test if longer warmup improves stability and convergence for the LR=0.03, WD=0.1 configuration, following agent-9's success with longer warmup at this LR.
